entries.german: Ruprecht bestätigt das von Eberhard von Rosenberg seiner gemahlin Else von Erlekeim verschriebene wittum mit zu Bocksberg gehörigen gütern.
entries.english: Ruprecht confirms the inheritance bequeathed by Eberhard von Rosenberg to his wife Elisabeth von Erligheim, including property belonging to Boxberg.

facts.content: had granted a Wittum to his wife Elisabeth von Erligheim.
had endowed the Wittum with properties belonging to Boxberg.
confirmed the Wittum granted by [vogt_zu_Lauda] to Elisabeth von Erligheim.
